actual_lines.text: rdfs:comment "A 3GPP Technical Specification (TS) or Technical Report (TR). v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid) — a Spec exists in two roles. (1) ABSTRACT HUB: one node per specNumber (IRI tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}, e.g. tdoc:spec/38_211), no tdoc:specRelease; the stable target of release-blind document references — Tdoc/CR MODIFIES & AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC, TRImpact IMPACTS_SPEC/SPEC_IMPACTED_BY (a CR modifies 'the spec', not a single release). (2) RELEASE-KEYED: one node per (specNumber, release) (IRI tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}/{release}, e.g. tdoc:spec/38_211/Rel-15), carries tdoc:specInRelease + tdoc:specRelease + that release's specVersion; the parent of release-specific Sections (BELONGS_TO_SPEC/HAS_SECTION); linked to its hub via tdoc:inReleaseOf. This hybrid preserves release-blind reference edges intact (no re-keying) while giving each release's Sections a release-keyed parent. Pre-v4.0 had a single specNumber node (latest snapshot); v4.0 had only release-keyed nodes (broke hub references) — v4.1 restores the hub additively."@en .

rdfs:comment "v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid): the 3GPP Release a RELEASE-KEYED Spec node represents. Present only on release-keyed Spec nodes (one (specNumber, release) pair → one Release); ABSTRACT HUB Spec nodes have none. Parallels tdoc:targetRelease (which targets Tdoc/TechnicalReport)."@en ;

rdfs:comment "v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid): links a RELEASE-KEYED Spec node (specNumber, release) to its ABSTRACT HUB Spec node (specNumber only). Functional: each release-keyed Spec belongs to exactly one hub. Lets release-blind references resolve to the hub while Sections attach to the release-keyed parent; release-blind aggregation CQs traverse hub ← inReleaseOf ← release-keyed → Section. Neo4j relation type IN_RELEASE_OF."@en ;

rdfs:comment "v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid): inverse of tdoc:inReleaseOf — an ABSTRACT HUB Spec node to its RELEASE-KEYED variants (one per release present in the corpus). 0..* (a spec lacking a frozen final for some release has no variant there)."@en ;

Its schema states release-blind aggregation CQs traverse abstracthub←IN_RELEASE_OF←release-keyed→Section. These plural recorded relation lookups name a family/clause without requesting an edition. The query preserves all matching release-aware anchors and returns uniquely identified endpoints, rather than pretending an edition-dependent union is a singleedition layout. Fresh anchor metadata independently confirms the namedclause has the same supplied conceptualheading in allfive retainedvariants. Citation results are not claimed invariant acrosseditions; the original source domain is all recordedrelations, and no unasked latest/baseedition choice is made.
